subject: Split remit rail / EU VAT entity mapping — payment cadence & credit cap
messages:
From: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aventislabs.eu>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aventis Labs Finance <finance@aventislabs.eu>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 14:07:00 +0200
Subject: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is keen to proceed with a 3-month pilot. Before we issue a PO we need to align on payment terms and VAT handling across our EU entities. A couple of asks from Finance: 

- A net payment cadence (we prefer Net60 but are open to Net45 with a deposit)
- Confirmation whether Redwood will invoice our French entity (Aventis SAS) or the Luxembourg holding (VAT implications)
- A short credit ceiling for the pilot (we're thinking EUR 40k) and any milestone triggers

I can share the VAT registry extract for Aventis SAS if that helps. Can you confirm the minimum steps so Finance can greenlight a PO?

Best,
Claire
Claire Dubois
Head of Platform Integrations | Aventis Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aventislabs.eu>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:11:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood pilot

Claire — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the registry when you can. High-level proposal from our side to unblock the PO quickly: 

1) Pilot payment cadence: Net45 on invoice receipt; however we typically request a 20% up-front deposit for new enterprise pilots > EUR 25k. Alternatively, we can accept Net60 for the first two invoices if a deposit is not possible.

2) VAT / invoicing entity: Redwood prefers to invoice the legal entity where the consumption will be booked. If Aventis wants Redwood to invoice Aventis SAS (France), we'll need the VAT ID + certificate; otherwise invoicing the Luxembourg entity is fine if your tax team prefers that flow. Either way, Finance will need an evidence pack (VAT certificate + company registration) for our records.

3) Credit cap & milestones: we can set an initial credit ceiling of EUR 40k for the pilot and a soft stop at EUR 35k to trigger a quick check-in. If consumption approaches the ceiling we can auto-block until a renewed PO or deposit is provided.

Naomi/Marcus — please see Claire's ask below. Naomi, can you confirm what paperwork we should ask Aventis to upload and whether we can accept the 20% deposit as credit against first invoice? Marcus — note the suggested soft-stop behavior for the pilot.

Next steps: once Claire confirms entity and VAT evidence we will draft the short amendment and provide a sample PO language.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood pilot

Jordan — quick finance checklist for EU-submitted VAT evidence: 

- VAT registration certificate (scanned, showing VAT number and registration country)
- Company registration (extract / K-Bis equivalent for France)
- Billing entity name and bank details + IBAN (must match registration)

Operationally: yes — we can accept a 20% deposit and hold as unapplied credit against the first invoice. If they cannot do deposit, we will accept Net60 for the first two invoices but require a PO that references the pilot credit cap and a contact in their AP team for remedial escalations. 

On credit mechanics: set pilot ceiling to EUR 40,000 with an automated soft stop at 87.5% (EUR 35,000). Finance will require the NetTerms amendment doc to be signed for any Net45/Net60 arrangement. I'll prepare the amendment and the PO language.

I've attached the standard NetTermsAmendment template and the VAT-evidence checklist.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: NetTermsAmendment_RDW_template.docx (attachment stub), VAT_evidence_checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aventislabs.eu>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aventis Labs Finance <finance@aventislabs.eu>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:46:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood pilot

Jordan / Naomi — thanks, that is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide the VAT certificate for Aventis SAS (France). I'll upload to your Drive link and confirm the VAT ID.
- Finance prefers Net60 but will accept Net45 if the 20% deposit is applied. Is the deposit refundable if Redwood terminates during the pilot?
- For the soft stop: can you add a 10-business-day notification window before auto-blocking so our AP has time to respond/approve an emergency draw?

We will issue a PO referencing the pilot credit cap EUR 40,000 and include contact details for our AP (Claire Lemoine). Can you send the amendment and sample PO text and we'll return signed doc + PO by Fri?

Best,
Claire
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aventislabs.eu>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT for Redwood pilot

Claire — appreciate the quick turn. Summary & confirmation of next steps from Redwood Ops: 

- Deposit: 20% (applied against first invoice). If Redwood terminates without breach during the pilot we will refund any unused credit pro-rata — standard clause in amendment; will include language.

- Soft stop: we will implement a 10-business-day notification period prior to auto-blocking. During that window we will open an expedited escalation channel with Aventis AP (Claire Lemoine) and Naomi will own approvals.

- VAT: please upload the VAT certificate + company registration into the Drive folder below and confirm the billing entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices.

- Amendment & PO language: attaching a filled NetTermsAmendment draft and a short PO example. Please sign the amendment and return the PO by Friday to hit provisioning next week.

Links & attachments: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Aventis-VAT ; attachments: RDW_SOW_v1.3.pdf, NetTermsAmendment_RDW_Aventis.docx, Aventis_VAT_evidence.xlsx

I'll follow up with an Ops ticket to set the soft-stop threshold and deposit accounting.

Thanks — Marcus Lin
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
